Why the burn works mechanics

00Zero maker/taker fees. Your only cost is the spread — $50–70 per $1M on crypto pairs, $130–200 per $1M on the liquid RWA pairs.
01Points weight open interest and hold time far above raw volume. A $20k book held for hours beats a $200k book scalped.
02Hold, don't scalp. A position has to sit on the book at least 1 hour to score properly, and 7 hours or more is where the weighting really pays.
03Delta-neutral works: take the funding-positive side on Omni, hedge the same notional on Binance or Hyperliquid.

Why late entry still works

→Emissions are fixed per week, not per trader. Thinner competition means a larger slice of the same 150k.
→A referral code adds a 10–15% points boost that compounds on every remaining distribution.
→RWA markets are new and under-farmed: long the stock spot, short the perp, collect spread and points at once.
→Swaps land with the lowest fees on the venue — the same points for a materially smaller burn once Phase 2 ships.
→A bonus-weighted competition is coming alongside them, stacking multipliers on top of the base emission for anyone already positioned.
